mismatch.message: unsupported hero move: switch_terrain() onto terrain that blocks levitation

summary: The current A21 replay emits all 73 recorded screens, with all 3713 RNG values and 73 cursors matching; no recorded screen is missing. The only remaining diagnostic is a post-recording behavioral boundary at step 73: js/hack.js switch_terrain() throws when the hero occupies obstructed, closed-door, waterwall or lavawall terrain. C hack.c switch_terrain() handles that same blocklev predicate by setting BLevitation/BFlying FROMOUTSIDE, issuing messages only when the corresponding property is active, updating the status line when a property changes, and classifying terrain. This boundary is therefore a future whole-source switch_terrain port with zero currently unmatched recorded screens; the prior tutorial reached-depth explanation is superseded.

source.branch: hack.c switch_terrain() 3178-3217 computes blocklev from IS_OBSTRUCTED, closed_door, IS_WATERWALL and LAVAWALL. On blocklev it sets BLevitation and BFlying FROMOUTSIDE, with You_cant() output only for active Levitation/Flying; otherwise it clears those masks and invokes float_up()/float_vs_flight() as needed. It then updates disp.botl when Levitation/Flying changed and calls classify_terrain() when terrainstatus is enabled. js/hack.js 4794-4824 computes the same predicate but throws UnsupportedHeroMoveBoundaryError at 4811-4813, and similarly refuses nonzero blocked masks at 4815-4819 instead of implementing those source state transitions.
callers: hack.c set_uinwater() 3221-3227 calls switch_terrain() only when u.uinwater changes; js/hack.js set_uinwater() 4827-4836 is the corresponding owner and js/cmd.js 2573 uses it during level transitions.

hack.c spoteffects() 3342-3349 calls switch_terrain() before pooleffects() when the current terrain differs from the previous terrain or terrain_typ is MAX_TYPE; js/hack.js spoteffects() 4938-4970 calls its terrain check after pooleffects(), so a liquid death that returns true skips this call.

dungeon.c u_on_rndspot() 1604-1638 calls switch_terrain() after random level arrival; js/dungeon.js u_on_rndspot() 1156-1214 calls the current JS owner, and js/cmd.js 2583-2589 is a production level-change caller.
teleport.c teleds() 551-552 calls switch_terrain() after a terrain-type change; js/teleport.js 1601-1606 preserves this call after map and vision updates.
dothrow.c 913-917 calls switch_terrain() after thrown movement changes terrain; js/dothrow.js 643-649 is the corresponding caller.
dig.c 733 and 757 calls switch_terrain() after a hero-created pit or hole changes solid terrain; no direct js/dig.js caller currently exists for these unported post-trap arms.
monmove.c dissolve_bars() 2169-2177 calls switch_terrain() when bars dissolve under the hero; js/monmove.js 4035-4048 preserves that caller.
objnam.c wizterrainwish() 3907-3910 calls switch_terrain() after a terrain wish; the corresponding JS terrain-wish path remains unported and has no direct caller.
dependencies: Terrain classification requires the canonical IS_OBSTRUCTED, closed_door, IS_WATERWALL and LAVAWALL predicates and the current level cell at u.ux/u.uy.

The source state contract owns u.uprops[LEVITATION].blocked and u.uprops[FLYING].blocked (BLevitation/BFlying), plus float_up(), float_vs_flight(), disp.botl and classify_terrain(); a future implementation must preserve their source order and conditional messages.
